# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). It applies in issues, pull requests, the Unraid forum thread and any other space where the project is discussed.

Short version: be respectful, assume good faith, keep feedback about the work, and no harassment or discrimination.

To report a problem privately, use [GitHub's private reporting](https://github.com/alexanderschubert/ugreen-nas-control/security/advisories/new) and say it is a conduct report. The maintainers handle reports confidentially and decide on consequences as described in the Covenant's enforcement guidelines.
